The heated steering wheel adds warmth on cold mornings. These features work together to keep all occupants comfortable on long drives or during winter weather.The Ascent Limited operates on a 2.4-liter 4-cylinder DOHC engine with all-wheel drive and a continuously variable transmission for responsive acceleration and efficient fuel economy at 19 mpg city and 25 mpg highway. Electronic Stability Control, four-wheel independent suspension, and speed-sensing steering provide confident handling in varied conditions. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags protect occupants. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation. description: The Galpin Premier Collection is truly proud to be able to offer this exceptional E39 M5 for sale today with just under 80,000 original miles since new.Introduced in 1998 at the Geneva Motor Show, the E39 generation was the first M5 to use a V8 engine, (S62 4,9L) resulting in an increase in power output to 395hp at 6,600rpm and 369lb/ft of torque. The S62 engine has electronically actuated individual throttle bodies, an aluminum block and heads, variable valve timing (double-VANOS), and a semi-dry sump oil system. Paired to the engine is a Getrag 420G six-speed manual and limited slip differential.The E39 was also the first M5 to use aluminum front suspension components and a multi-link rear suspension. Production began in October 1998 and continued through to the end of 2003 model year production.Production of the E39 generation amounted to a global total of 20,482 units. For the first time, the M5 was produced on the same assembly line as the regular 5 Series models at the Dingolfing factory in Germany.The official performance figures are a 060 mph acceleration time of 4.8 seconds and an electronically limited top speed of 155 mph. In testing, an unrestricted M5 reached a top speed in excess of 186 mph and recorded a Nurburgring lap time of just 8 minutes and 20 seconds.This example was produced at the Digolfing facility in late-April 2000 and supplied to its first owner in Pennsylvania in July 2000.  In total, this excellent example has been cared for by a total of four owners and has spent the past thirteen years residing in California. description: This 1992 Dodge Daytona ES is finished in Radiant Fire with a grey cloth interior and a five-speed manual transmission, and it has a story behind it worth knowing. The car was stored for 15 years before being pulled out during the pandemic and given a full repaint in 2020, bringing it back to life in a color that turns heads and suits the wedge profile of the Daytona extremely well. Under the hood is the 3.0 liter V6, the same Mitsubishi 6G72 engine family used in the Eclipse and 3000GT, producing 141 horsepower and backing it up with 167 pound-feet of torque through the five-speed. It is a smooth, willing motor that suits the Daytona's front-wheel drive sports coupe character without asking too much of the drivetrain. The Dodge Daytona ran from 1984 through 1993 and was Chrysler's answer to the Japanese sport compact invasion of the 1980s. Dodge positioned it directly against the Celica, the 200SX, and even the Porsche 944 in some of their advertising, which was ambitious but not entirely wrong given the handling balance the platform delivered. 1992 brought the final facelift of the generation, switching from the pop-up headlights of earlier models back to fixed units in a cleaner, more modern design, and the last Daytona ever produced rolled off the line in February 1993. That makes a 1992 ES one of the final expressions of a car that closed out a decade of Mopar sports coupe history. The interior is clean and well equipped with power locks, power mirrors, cruise control, air conditioning and heat, and a Kenwood stereo. Crank windows are correct for the ES trim level and keep the cabin simple. The Radiant Fire paint from the 2020 repaint shows well and gives this car a presence on the street that a 30-year-old Daytona sitting on a shelf for 15 years had no business having. The Dodge Daytona is one of the more overlooked 1980s and early 1990s sports coupes in the collector market, and clean, well-presented examples that have been properly brought back are exactly what that market tends to reward when buyers pay attention. Combined with a close-ratio 5-speed manual transmission, sport suspension, limited production numbers, and exceptional chassis balance, the 318is delivers a driving experience that remains engaging more than three decades later.Finished in Brilliant Red over Natural Tan sport interior, this 1991 BMW 318is has covered 89,852 original miles since new. Produced on June 28, 1990, this well-equipped example retains its factory sport seats, air conditioning, power windows, airbag steering wheel, outdoor temperature display, and original alloy wheels. BMW production records confirm the car remains in its original factory configuration with no documented retrofits. This example carries an especially meaningful history with Enthusiast Auto Group. We originally sold the car to its most recent owner in 2015, who has cared for it over the past decade before returning it to us. Opportunities to reacquire cars we know personally are always special, allowing us to present a vehicle whose stewardship we have been familiar with for many years.The accompanying CARFAX reflects an impressive ownership history, documenting no accidents or damage, six documented service visits, and long-term ownership. Early records show the car spending its first two decades in Texas before moving briefly through California and Florida. EAG acquired the car in early 2014 before selling it to its long-term Ohio owner, who retained it until its recent return. Earlier documented maintenance includes a fuel system refresh, water pump, alternator, A/C system overhaul, cooling fan clutch, belts, and ignition service. Prior to being offered for sale, this 318is will complete Enthusiast Auto Group's comprehensive preservation process, including a detailed mechanical inspection, road testing, fluid verification, and completion of any maintenance or preservation items identified during our evaluation. description: This 2024 Honda Civic EX offers a refined driving experience with modern technology and practical efficiency combined into one well-rounded sedan.  - 180-Watt Audio System with 8 speakers - Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) with Low-Speed Follow - Blind Spot Information (BSI) System warning - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration - Auto High-beam Headlights - Power moonroof - Heated front seats - Leather steering wheel and shift knob - Leather-trimmed heated front bucket seats - Front dual zone automatic temperature control - Exterior parking camera with rear view - 17" alloy wheels with gloss black inserts - Electronic Stability Control and traction control - HondaLink emergency communication system  The exterior presents a clean appearance with Platinum White Pearl paint and body-color bumpers that maintain the vehicle's cohesive design. The 17" alloy wheels with gloss black inserts provide a contemporary aesthetic while the heated door mirrors and variably intermittent wipers ensure practicality in various weather conditions.  Inside the cabin, you'll find heated front bucket seats with leather accents and a front center armrest for added comfort during your commute. The leather steering wheel is telescoping and tilt-adjustable, allowing you to find your ideal driving position. A leather shift knob complements the interior appointments while remote keyless entry and illuminated entry provide convenient access.  Technology is seamlessly integrated with a 180-watt audio system featuring steering wheel-mounted controls and support for Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The automatic temperature control maintains separate zones for driver and passenger comfort, while the power moonroof adds an open-air element to your driving experience.  Safety and convenience features work together throughout this Civic EX. Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow assists during highway and stop-and-go traffic, while the Blind Spot Information system alerts you to vehicles in adjacent lanes. Auto high-beam headlights and delay-off functionality enhance visibility, and an exterior parking camera provides rearview assistance when maneuvering.  Fuel efficiency remains practical with an estimated 33 MPG city and 42 MPG highway, supported by the 1.5L four-cylinder engine and continuously variable transmission. Electronic Stability Control, four-wheel independent suspension, and speed-sensing steering deliver composed handling and confidence on the road.
